idea-plugin.name: Akeyless Agentic Runtime Authority
idea-plugin.description:
Akeyless Agentic Runtime Authority (ARA)

Securely query databases, execute cloud / Kubernetes / GitHub actions, and run commands on SSH, Windows, and LDAP servers through Akeyless without exposing credentials in the IDE or to AI agents.

Features

  • list-secrets — discover ARA-enabled dynamic, rotated, and custom-MCP secrets, and SSH certificate issuers
  • query-db — run SQL / DB commands with server-side JIT credentials
  • service-execute — AWS, GCP, Azure, Kubernetes, GitHub, custom MCP, and remote commands on SSH, Windows, and LDAP items (Gateway 5.6.0+)
  • list-sub-tools — discover sub-tools for a service secret or remote item
  • Settings UI — Gateway URL and auth (PasswordSafe for secrets)
  • SAML / OIDC — browser login on first use

Getting Started

  1. Open Settings → Tools → Akeyless ARA
  2. Set Gateway URL and authentication method
  3. Open Tools → Show Akeyless ARA
  4. Click Refresh secrets, then run queries or service actions

Requirements

  • JetBrains IDE 2024.3 or later (PyCharm, IntelliJ IDEA, and others)
  • Akeyless Gateway with Agentic Runtime Authority configured
  • Valid Akeyless account / access credentials

Matches the Claude / Cursor ARA connectors and akeyless mcp-runtime-authority, implemented natively in the IDE (no CLI or Node required for core use).

For more information, visit akeyless.io and ARA docs.
idea-plugin.change-notes:
0.2.0
  • Remote commands (Gateway 5.6.0+): list and run commands on SSH, Windows, and LDAP rotated secrets, RDP and LDAP dynamic secrets, and SSH certificate issuers
  • Requests wait up to 270 seconds, like the Akeyless CLI, so long remote commands are not cut off
  • SAML / OIDC login exchanges a one-time auth code through the Gateway instead of receiving credentials in the callback URL
0.1.3
  • Initial Marketplace-ready release
  • ARA tool window: list-secrets, query-db, service-execute, list-sub-tools
  • Settings UI with PasswordSafe for Access Key / JWT
  • Supports access_key, saml, oidc, jwt, and universal_identity
  • PyCharm 2026.2 compatibility (no until-build cap)
